subject.title: fix(sessions): keep dirty transcript search from blocking the gateway

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this persisted claim-generation and single-slot worker/watchdog lifecycle as the canonical transcript-index reconciliation contract?
rationale: Tests and runtime proof support the implementation, but accepting the durable state encoding, lease behavior, and process-wide scheduling policy requires session-state owner intent rather than automated correctness judgment.

options.title: Approve the lifecycle contract
options.body: Accept the current claim, invalidation, queue, and watchdog semantics and land after exact-head checks and mergeability complete.

options.title: Request separate claim state
options.body: Require the contributor to separate transient rebuild ownership from the durable dirty marker before merge, with corresponding schema and upgrade analysis.

recommendation.title: Approve the lifecycle contract
recommendation.body: Accept the current claim, invalidation, queue, and watchdog semantics and land after exact-head checks and mergeability complete.

likelyOwner.reason: This is the best available routing candidate for a repository-level session persistence and Gateway lifecycle decision.
